name: Greeting
when: A new chat, or someone coming back

variants.name: Wave
variants.desc: Happy eyes and a big wave.

variants.name: Pop in
variants.desc: Pops up out of nowhere with a few sparkles.

variants.name: Hat tip
variants.desc: Lifts a little top hat to say hello.

variants.name: Peek in
variants.desc: Peeks out from behind a wall, then hops in.

variants.name: Wink
variants.desc: Tilts, winks and adds a sparkle.

parts.t: <g class="cheeks"><ellipse cx="{{a.ck1}}" cy="{{a.cky}}" rx="6" ry="3.4"></ellipse><ellipse cx="{{a.ck2}}" cy="{{a.cky}}" rx="6" ry="3.4"></ellipse></g>

<g class="eg eg-n" stroke="{{a.eye}}"><g transform="translate({{a.lex}} {{a.ley}})"><path class="gl" d="M-5 2Q0 -4 5 2"></path></g><g transform="translate({{a.rex}} {{a.rey}})"><path class="gl" d="M-5 2Q0 -4 5 2"></path></g></g>

<g class="fx-hand" transform="translate({{a.side}} {{a.mo}})"><g transform="translate(85 47)"><g class="a hnd"><path class="hc" d="M-4 0C-6 -4 -5.5 -11 0 -11.5C5.5 -11 6 -4 4 0Z"></path></g><path class="a mot grey" d="M-9 -15Q-12 -10 -10 -5M9 -15Q12 -10 10 -5"></path></g></g>

<g class="fx-tiphat" transform="translate(0 {{a.up}})"><g transform="translate(50 18)"><g class="a htip"><rect class="dk" x="-8" y="-15" width="16" height="14" rx="1.5"></rect><rect class="coral" x="-7.6" y="-5.5" width="15.2" height="2.8"></rect><rect class="dk" x="-13" y="-2" width="26" height="3.6" rx="1.8"></rect></g></g></g>
<g class="fx-wall"><rect x="-26" y="4" width="38" height="88" rx="4" fill="#E2DED6"></rect><path d="M12 8V88" fill="none" stroke="#CFC9BE" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"></path></g>
<g class="fx-wsparkle"><g transform="translate({{a.wkx}} {{a.wky}})"><path class="a wsp gold" d="M0 -4.5L1.3 -1.3L4.5 0L1.3 1.3L0 4.5L-1.3 1.3L-4.5 0L-1.3 -1.3Z"></path></g></g>
